title: Palace Messenger
subtitle: Bearer of Ptolemy's Dispatches
bodyText: A palace messenger carries sealed orders through crowded courtyards and unfamiliar streets. Dependability gives distant officials a common purpose, keeping the first threads of government joined by a message delivered intact and on time.
sceneBrief: A modest messenger carries a sealed papyrus dispatch through an Egyptian administrative colonnade, simple pale tunic and satchel, no royal diadem.
rarityCharacteristics: plain iron, single rule, square corner joints
